note: Pole-roots round 2 (pole-roots-r2): every source tried for the poles the NGII 2025 sheet left unresolved; fetch/poleRoots.mjs merges these into data/photo/pole-roots.json. A pole moves only when a source resolves its base to <= 0.5 m; none did, so the 49 stay at their survey seeds, estimated (추정). seedUncertaintyM: the median shift from seed to resolved root of the poles of the same source (data.go.kr 2.43 / 4.99 / 7.45 m; by-eye survey 0-3.07 m, median 1.2 m), an estimate.

sources.ngii-wide-search: lib/poleShadow.mjs detectPoleRoots on the NGII 2025 sheet over 3.5 m around each seed (the first round searched 1 m around by-eye bases only), top 3 candidates reviewed by eye on 8x and 16x chips; on the 15 resolved poles the same search returns the known shadow roots within 0.05 m (OB0001, OC0060, OC0061)
sources.vworld-z19: VWorld Satellite z19 (data/ortho/vworld-satellite-z19.*) registers to the sheet at 0.00-0.01 m with NCC 0.89-0.95 at all 15 resolved poles, with the same shadows, vehicles and roofs: it is the same 2025 photo, not a second epoch
sources.ngii-other-epochs: NGII publishes 2022-2024 orthophotos of sheet 34702020, but only behind login, cart and the INNORIX client (map.ngii.go.kr); none is available locally or without login. The keyless 순천시 GIS aerials (12 cm, 2022-2024) are All Rights Reserved, internal QA only, and were not used
sources.esri-z18: Esri World Imagery z18 (0.49 m/px, another epoch, strong relief lean) sits 4-6 m north of the sheet; local registration (gradient NCC, +-10 m) reaches NCC <= 0.40 with a 0.3-14 m spread between window quadrants at the 15 resolved poles, so no root can be carried to the sheet within 0.5 m
sources.vr-two-ray: scripts/perf/vr_lamp_bearings.py rays from the 33 resected stations (a8, c3, d4, d5 excluded), each ray required to show the pole ridge at its base rows, pairs crossing at >= 20 deg, sigma from the station yaw residual and 1 px <= 0.5 m: 32 of the 49 poles have no station within 45 m, 14 one, 3 two; no pair qualified
sources.shadow-tip: root = shadow tip moved back toward the sun by h / tan 62 deg; with heights estimated (+-1 m) the along-shadow error is about 0.5 m before the tip is located, so no tip-only pole reaches 0.5 m
